latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Executes named dependency-breaking techniques from "Working Effectively with Legacy Code" to make legacy classes/methods testable.

- Selects and applies the appropriate one of 24 dependency-breaking techniques based on language, dependency type, and context.
- Guides users through diagnosing the exact obstacle to testability and choosing the safest mechanical refactoring.
- Supports input of code, language, and a description of the testability obstacle.
- Integrates with related skills, including test-harness diagnostics and seam identification.
- Documents all dependency breaks in dependency-break-log.md for traceability.
- Works across multiple languages and legacy scenarios, with steps tailored to each situation.
